_comment: Live detection cases (Tier 2): the playbook wazuh-mustfire-live.yml performs real, marked, self-cleaning actions on one test agent, then 'must_fire.py live' asks the indexer whether each produced an alert. Cases are matched on the unique marker (user name, file name or container name), the rule ids and the level floor. 'needs' lists capabilities the test host must have: none for a plain LXC, 'docker' for a Docker host. Ids were calibrated against live alerts on 2026-10-15 (apt-cacher-stack); the docker ids are from the Tier 1 samples and still need their first live run.

cases.name: ssh login as a non-existent user
docker exec of a non-health-check command
